free_tier.stated: Early access includes USD 250 in free credit, no card required and no minimum spend; after that, vCPU is USD 0.0436 per vCPU-hour, memory USD 0.0096 per GiB-hour and storage USD 0.0001 per GiB-hour, billed by the second on allocated size. A base-small sandbox (1 vCPU, 1 GiB, 4 GiB disk) is USD 0.0536 per hour.
free_tier.notes: The USD 250 is early-access credit, not a recurring free tier. Pause stops CPU and RAM charges; storage bills for running and paused runtimes, private templates and snapshots.

per_object_cap.stated: A verified Tier 0 account can use 10 vCPU, 20 GiB RAM and 50 GiB disk in total; a base-large template is 4 vCPU, 4 GiB RAM and 8 GiB disk.
per_object_cap.notes: The numbers are per-account resource ceilings, not a single-sandbox object cap; the largest published template is base-large.

retention.stated: Kill removes the runtime. Storage is billed for running and paused runtimes, private templates and snapshots; a paused sandbox keeps its filesystem, and no automatic deletion period is published on the pages read.

egress.terms: A new sandbox cannot reach the public internet. Attach a network policy: listed destinations are allowed and everything else is denied. No policy attached means blocked, metadata and link-local are always blocked, and DNS still resolves. No per-GB egress price or allowance is published on the pages read.

interface_detail: Python and TypeScript SDKs, a gravixlayer CLI and a REST API at https://api.gravixlayer.ai/v1; runtimes expose an agent user for SSH and a web terminal. Network-policies and identity providers are also managed through the SDK and CLI.
tooling: gravixlayer Python SDK, TypeScript SDK, gravixlayer CLI, REST API; templates built from public Docker images or a Dockerfile; base-small, base-medium, base-large, browser-small, desktop-small, claude and codex templates.
chaining: Secrets are stored once as identity providers and attached to a runtime as environment variables on each run, while a default-deny network policy limits the sandbox to named model APIs and registries; a sandbox can mount an S3 bucket at boot and keep files after the run.

limits.value: 10 vCPU, 20 GiB RAM and 50 GiB disk per verified Tier 0 account

limits_note: A runtime that exceeds its timeout is terminated. Billing is on allocated size, not observed utilization: a 2 vCPU sandbox that is idle costs the same as one at full CPU.
binding_note: The 10 vCPU / 20 GiB RAM / 50 GiB disk per-account ceiling caps a single account's fleet before the 100 creations-per-minute rate does; the USD 250 credit is one-time and only delays the charge.

identity_cost.detail: The early-access page renders 'Email is all we need.' with an Email field and no card, phone or ID field; the pricing page states 'No card required.' The published quota table is conditioned on 'Account verified', and what that verification asks for is not stated on the pages read.

reliability_note: Runtimes deny outbound traffic by default and a runtime that exceeds its timeout is terminated. Billing is on allocated size, not observed utilization. The service is in private preview and access is by early-access request.
confidence_note: Rates, credit, quotas, egress behaviour and the email-only gate are quoted from the vendor's own pricing page, documentation and early-access page, all read 2026-11-24; the account-verification fields are unverified: not stated on the pages read.
